english.meaning: to come or go down toward the speaker
english.note: 帶埋落來 means bring it down too.

exampleSentences.english: They went up to buy it for me, and kindly brought it down too.
exampleSentences.traditional: 係上去幫我買嘅。噉佢呢就好好喇，幫我帶埋落來𠻹。

exampleSentences.english: So pretty. Just pull down the metal gate and lock it.
exampleSentences.traditional: 好鬼靚。即鐵閘拉落來鎖住啊。
